cards.title: Kindness of Strangers: Help on a Busy Motorway
cards.body: A parent's car journey turned chaotic when their child became ill. A compassionate stranger emerged with help, reminding us of human decency in overwhelming moments.

cards.title: Family Memoir Conflict: When to Cut Ties
cards.body: A sister-in-law published a family memoir containing unfair portrayals of the questioner's partner. Expert advice explores whether reconciliation is possible when family stories diverge.

cards.title: Open Relationships With Young Kids
cards.body: Michael and Selena practice ethical non-monogamy while raising three young children. They credit the arrangement with energizing their relationship and partnership.

cards.title: Suburban Life and Parenting Perspective
cards.body: A family's move to Melbourne's suburbs initially seemed dull until they discovered unexpected community and social opportunities. The transition shifted their view of suburban family life.

cards.title: Ikea Shop Reveals Parenting Wisdom Gaps
cards.body: Taking a child to Ikea becomes a moment of reckoning about domestic skills parents have—or haven't—taught them. It's a humorous look at parenting gaps exposed by everyday situations.

cards.title: Healthy Phone Practices for Teens and Tweens
cards.body: Deciding when to give a child their first phone is a critical parental decision requiring careful consideration. Setting expectations and boundaries before making the leap is essential.

cards.title: Stop Blaming Kids for Tech Designed to Capture
cards.body: Screens and content aren't the real problem—the machinery behind them teaches developing brains unhealthy patterns about attention and reward. Understanding the system helps parents make better decisions.

cards.title: What Is the Screen Replacing in Children's Lives
cards.body: Before limiting screen time, parents should ask what activity or interaction the screen is replacing. This perspective shift can guide more thoughtful screen management decisions.

cards.title: Breaking the Anxiety Cycle in Children
cards.body: Better breathing techniques can help calm tension and interrupt anxious thinking in stressed children. Cyclic sighing offers a practical four-step method to manage stress.

cards.title: Teaching 9/11 to Students Born After It Happened
cards.body: A communication professor and her 18-year-old students explore how historical events are remembered across generations who didn't experience them. Understanding collective memory shapes how we teach children.

cards.title: Two Ways Parents Unintentionally Make Kids Feel Worse
cards.body: When trying to help stressed loved ones, good intentions can backfire. New research reveals how parental support attempts can accidentally worsen a child's emotional state.

cards.title: Tooth Grinding in Young People Rising
cards.body: More young people are grinding their teeth, causing flattened molars and facial pain. Getting proper treatment early can be life-changing for developing teens.

cards.title: Student Loan Terms Made Clearer for Borrowers
cards.body: New changes will help students understand that governments can alter loan rules and career choices affect repayments. Greater transparency supports informed financial decisions for young people.

cards.title: Best Friends Discover They're Actually Sisters
cards.body: Meena and Minal were adopted from Mumbai orphanages in the 1980s and grew up as best friends in the Netherlands until a DNA test revealed they were sisters. The discovery transformed their already close relationship.
